updates.name: [BaseApp] Logger Data Column
updates.description: Updated Logger.log signature to use data payload and store caller key:value metadata in a single CSV data column instead of dynamic parsed columns.

updates.name: [BaseApp] Logger Dynamic Fields
updates.description: Added Logger.log fields support so caller-supplied key:value data is mapped to dynamic CSV columns and populated only on relevant rows.

updates.name: [BaseApp] Pullbase Local App Logs
updates.description: Updated pullbase logging to use local app identity and output path C:/data/{local_app}/{date}/basepulls/{local_app}_{timestamp}.(csv|html).

updates.name: [BaseApp] Instantiate Base Config Only
updates.description: Updated instantiate runtime config loading to use only base.json (no app.json override) for path and logging resolution.

updates.name: [BaseApp] Instantiate Fixed Log Path
updates.description: Updated instantiate logging output to C:/data/BaseApp/instantiations/{date}/{target_app}_{timestamp}.csv and matching HTML path.

updates.name: [BaseApp] Instantiate Pullbase Logging
updates.description: Added CSV+HTML logging to instantiate (base logs_path/instantiations, {target_app}_{timestamp}) and pullbase (app logs_path/basepulls, {base_app}_{timestamp}).

updates.name: [BaseApp] Manifest Folder Source Sync
updates.description: Added support for manifest entries whose source is a folder; instantiate and pullbase now sync all files recursively with optional target folder mapping.

updates.name: [BaseApp] Key Driven Manifest Folder
updates.description: Updated instantiate and pullbase to consume all JSON files from docs/manifests and apply behavior by key: instantiate uses once+pull, pullbase uses pull.

updates.name: [BaseApp] Manifest Source Target Schema
updates.description: Updated instantiate and pullbase manifest parsing to use section lists of items with required source and optional target defaulting to source.

updates.name: [BaseApp] Scripts And Manifest Dict
updates.description: Moved instantiate and pullbase into scripts/ and updated manifests to dict format with pull and once sections under docs/manifests.

updates.name: [BaseApp] Manifest Location Refactor
updates.description: Moved instantiate and pull manifests to docs/manifests (pull.json and once.json) and updated instantiate.py and pullbase.py to consume the new paths.
